metadata.review_update_2026_10_21: Prior resolved claims below are historical assertions, not independent verification. review-003, review-004 and review-005 reopened; Amanoaoac hall also unresolved. Explicit evacuation publication crosswalk supersedes historical all-pins policy: fac-006 and fac-012/013/014 list-only; fac-010 excluded. School positions and boundary containment cannot verify hall buildings. Original coordinates and prior resolution text retained as history.
metadata.description: Current facility review queue. Previous source_verified assertions and issue resolution text below are historical, not independent building verification. Exact publication policy and evacuation identity joins are in evacuation-crosswalk.json.
metadata.public_map_policy: Town Center excluded. fac-006 and fac-012/013/014 list-only, no pins. Eight named OSM school-footprint centroids are approximate source-reported locations, not surveyed entrances or current evacuation availability. Other source candidates remain approximate.

summary.note: Five identity/building/status issues reopened. Prior resolutions retained below as history. Old coordinate candidates preserved in facilities.geojson coordinate_history. Current operation and designation of local evacuation listings not confirmed.

issues.description: Police and Fire Station share exactly the same coordinates [120.4532, 16.0289] and the same Plus Code 2FG3+R7W. Verify whether they are genuinely co-located or whether one coordinate is a copied value.
issues.required_action: Cross-check with PNP and BFP directory or field confirmation. Do not assume distinct sites from identical coordinates.
issues.resolution: Maintainer confirmed Police and Fire stations are genuinely co-located at §3.5 cell centre [120.4532031, 16.0271125] (2FG3+R7W), not a copied value. Both features published with source_verified status and review_notes cleared.

feature_names: Bagong Urgent Care and Ambulatory Services (BUCAS) Center
issues.description: Address states 'Barangay Torres, Tubao, La Union' while described in source notes as a Mapandan/Torres facility. The coordinates [120.4485, 16.0195] fall within Mapandan bounds.
issues.required_action: Determine actual location. If in Tubao, La Union, do not include in Mapandan public layer.
issues.resolution: Maintainer confirmed use of newer BUCAS §3.5 coordinates (2F5F+C4, Mapandan context -> [120.4728125, 16.0085625]). Address corrected to 'Barangay Torres, Mapandan, Pangasinan'. Locality conflict resolved; feature published as source_verified with review_notes cleared.

feature_names: Mapandan National High School / Central School SPED Center
issues.description: Name conflates two potentially distinct entities: Mapandan National High School and Central School SPED Center. Source notes reference a separate 'Mapandan Central School SPED Center' with a different coordinate.
issues.current_review: Separate named Central School and NHS OSM footprints contradict the unsupported combined identity resolution below. fac-006 list-only; fac-017 uses the Central School footprint and receives the single Central School source listing.
issues.required_action: Verify whether these are colocated facilities or separate entities with conflated names. Cross-check with DepEd school masterlist.
issues.resolution: Maintainer confirmed identity resolution: Mapandan NHS and Central School SPED Center are identified as a single facility per §3.5 (2FG3+XFW). Feature published as source_verified with review_notes cleared.

issues.description: Nilombot Elementary longitude (120.4364) conflicts with Nilombot Barangay Hall longitude (120.4725). Verify whether these are distinct sites or one is a coordinate error.
issues.current_review: Prior hall move onto a school point was unsupported. Hall building unresolved, list-only. Previous resolution retained as history, not current evidence.
issues.required_action: Cross-check with DepEd masterlist and barangay records to confirm distinct coordinates.
issues.resolution: Point-in-polygon validation against the Nilombot barangay_gid boundary (PSGC ADM4) showed the previous coordinates [120.4725, 16.0238] fell outside Nilombot and inside Aserda. Maintainer re-resolved per plan §3.5: Nilombot Barangay Hall relocated to [120.4364, 16.0281] (Nilombot Elementary candidate, confirmed within the Nilombot polygon). Confirmed a separate site from Nilombot Elementary School. Feature published as source_verified with review_notes cleared.

issues.description: Both Baloling National High School [120.4528, 15.9982] and Baloling Barangay Hall [120.4531, 15.9985] use coordinates that are very close to each other. Verify they are distinct sites.
issues.current_review: Prior hall move onto the elementary-school Plus Code was unsupported. Hall building unresolved, list-only. Previous containment claims are not building evidence.
issues.required_action: Field-verification or higher-resolution source needed to confirm separate locations.
issues.source: AGENTS.md Section 4.2 (general guidance on shared/closest coordinates)
issues.resolution: Point-in-polygon validation against the Baloling barangay_gid boundary (PSGC ADM4) showed both previous coordinates ([120.4528, 15.9982] and [120.4531, 15.9985]) fell outside Baloling and inside Poblacion. Maintainer re-resolved per plan §3.5: Baloling Barangay Hall relocated to the §3.5 Plus Code cell centre [120.4571406, 16.0372375]; Baloling NHS relocated to the OSM school-footprint centroid [120.4581, 16.0377]. Both confirmed within the Baloling polygon and distinct sites. Both published as source_verified.

issues.description: Primicias school/hall entries share a coordinate pair with another facility. Verify distinct sites.
issues.resolution: §3.5 coordinates applied: Primicias NHS (XFWH+9X2) relocated to [120.4798906, 15.9958875]; Torres NHS coordinates confirmed. Both retained as source_verified.

issues.description: Both have descriptions related to assembly/shelter use. Do not label them as official evacuation centres without authoritative confirmation from the MDRRMO.
issues.current_review: Town Center excluded from publication. Tulagan receives its explicit undated local listing, not official/current designation; exact building and current availability remain unconfirmed. Historical resolution below is not current verification.
issues.required_action: Confirm evacuation centre status with Mapandan MDRRMO / LNRMO before publishing with evacuation centre labeling.
issues.resolution: Mapandan Town Center (fac-010) and Tulagan Gym (fac-011) coordinate conflicts resolved per §3.5 (Tulagan Gym uses 2FG3+FJX). Review notes about evacuation-center labeling retained in source data and stripped from public payload by the publication gate. Both published as source_verified.

issues.description: Several barangay hall coordinates appear to reuse addresses or approximate locations rather than exact building footprints. Plus Code alone does not constitute a centroid from an official boundary polygon.
issues.current_review: Amanoaoac hall candidate falls in indicative Poblacion polygon, not evidence for its named barangay. Baloling hall was moved to a school candidate. Both are list-only with no verified building. Existing Poblacion/Santa Maria candidates remain approximate source locations, not independently verified buildings. Earlier resolution retained as history.
issues.required_action: Independently verify hall locations against barangay records or higher-resolution imagery.
issues.resolution: §3.5 Plus Code coordinates applied where available (fac-016 Municipal Hall 2FG3+Q5). Remaining halls retained with existing candidate coordinates. All published as source_verified per maintainer review decision.

external_issues.description: Santa Maria and Golden school records were marked 'Closed' in older undated supplied notes. fac-018/fac-022 now retain named OSM footprint locations with explicit unresolved operational-status warnings. Neither current operation nor availability is established.
external_issues.required_action: Cross-check school operational status with DepEd before adding to public map.

external_issues.description: Several elementary-school coordinates exactly reuse barangay-hall coordinates, indicating probable placeholder values rather than independently surveyed points.
external_issues.required_action: When adding elementary schools from DepEd masterlist, ensure coordinates come from independent sources, not copied from hall data.

external_issues.description: Any facility whose Plus Code, address, municipality, or coordinates disagree must be marked needs_review and excluded from public layers until resolved.
external_issues.required_action: Automated check: any feature with conflicting provenance fields must carry needs_review status.
